elaine_cs: Heads up — healthscore cohort shifted overnight, a bunch of onboarded accounts dropped to 'low'. Playbook automation fired re-engage nudges en masse. Anyone else seeing this?
miguel_ops: yep noticed. saw +12% in low-health counts on dashboard at 03:12 UTC. Seems correlated with last night's playbook transform job.
sam_pl: Which transform? the new 'reference_bucket' normalization we shipped?
elaine_cs: Yes. rollback suggested? It's causing churn in scheduling — customers getting 2x nudges :grimacing:.
ronny_eng: Investigating. Quick peek at the scoring logs shows a NaN -> 0 mapping in the batch transform for missing product_usage. The change was: 
```
# before
if product_usage is null: keep as null
# after (accidental)
if product_usage is null: product_usage = 0
```
Mapping null->0 drastically lowers percentile for a lot of legacy accounts.
miguel_ops: We did a dry-run but our sample missed legacy orgs with usage_hist = [] :facepalm: — that explains it.
sam_pl: If NaN/NULL became 0, the scoring function (we compute usage_pctile) will treat those as bottom decile. Suggest revert and set missing->UNKNOWN so scoring keeps previous imputation.
elaine_cs: Can we pause the playbook triggers while we fix? cs-bot is queuing nudges and some customers already got emails.
ronny_eng: Pausing triggers now. Executing: `/playbook pause health_reengage` — will post confirmation.
cs-bot: automation: playbook 'health_reengage' paused by ronny_eng at 04:08 UTC.
ronny_eng: Rolled back transform commit (reverted the null->0 line) and redeployed patched job. Will kick off a controlled backfill for affected accounts. ETA ~20m.
sam_pl: After backfill, let's snapshot pre/post scores and generate a list of accounts that received nudges incorrectly for CS to prioritize. SQL to pull sample: 
```sql
SELECT account_id, old_score, new_score FROM healthscore_audit WHERE batch_ts = '2026-03-22T03:00:00Z';
```
We should tag results to #csops.
elaine_cs: I'm already creating a triage board and will attach sample IDs. Please include any email recipients so we can send a follow-up apology note where needed.
ronny_eng: Backfill queued at 04:25 UTC. Will post when complete and share audit CSV.
cs-bot: automation: backfill job queued (job_id: bf-349001-01).
ronny_eng: Update: backfill finished at 05:02 UTC, delta export uploaded to S3 (`s3://redwood-cs/healthscore/deltas/3490012345.csv`). Posting link in #csops.
elaine_cs: Thanks — starting cleanups and suppression for anyone who got duplicate nudges.
miguel_ops: Recommend adding a small canary test for legacy cohorts to the deploy checklist so this doesn't slip again.
sam_pl: Agreed. I'll add a preflight that samples accounts with empty usage_hist.
elaine_cs: Great, appreciate the quick turnaround everyone :heart:
